source.description: Source book -- full title matching aon-cache's own `source` field, or a short code from lookups/sourcebooks.json.

replaces_class_feature.description: Free-text name of the class feature this archetype level swaps out, e.g. "Combat Feat". Unlike race.schema.json's alternate_traits[].replaces, this is rarely stated explicitly in the source text (0/248 sampled archetype-feature entries name it directly) -- the archetype's own flavor text usually just says 'alternate class feature at Nth level' and expects the reader to know their class's level table. Almost always null unless a human (or a confident LLM pass) fills it in; expect a _review note here by default.

requirements.description: Free text -- which class(es)/conditions qualify a character to take this archetype. Often sparse or empty in the source data (see _review).

flavor_text.description: The archetype's opening prose blurb (aon-cache data.effect, before the first level-feature heading).

levels.description: One entry per level at which this archetype grants or swaps a feature.

_source.description: aon-cache slugs this entry was assembled from (the archetype entry itself plus every linked archetype-feature).

_review.description: Anything the normalization script couldn't confidently fill in -- see race.schema.json's _review for the general convention. Expect at least one entry per level here (the replaces_class_feature gap above) until a human fills them in by hand.
